# Lucide social icons

The six SVG includes in `_includes/icons/` come from `lucide-static@0.562.0`, matching the icon library used by the reference website. Source: https://unpkg.com/lucide-static@0.562.0/icons/

Icons: github, book-open, twitter, linkedin, mail, and file-text. Only `aria-hidden` and `focusable` attributes were added for decorative use within labeled links. SVG paths are unchanged.

License: see [LICENSE](LICENSE). No runtime JavaScript or icon font is needed for these icons.
